primary_task: Optimize a project's developer workflow (build times, HMR, test run times) by analyzing its tooling and implementing configuration changes in the repository.

requirements.name: Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Glob, Grep
requirements.evidence: "tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Glob, Grep"; "4. Implement comprehensive developer experience enhancements"
requirements.basis: Manifest tools: "bash": "run shell commands on Linux x86_64 ...", "read": "read files in the working directory; search them by name pattern or content (glob, grep)", "write": "create and overwrite files", "edit": "edit existing files and Jupyter notebooks"

requirements.name: context-manager
requirements.evidence: "When invoked:\n1. Query context manager for development workflow and pain points"; "\"request_type\": \"get_dx_context\""
requirements.basis: The manifest does not name a context manager. It grants "agent": "start sub-agents that work in parallel, send them messages and list them" and "ask_user", but also lacks "connectors or integrations other than the tools listed". Would need to check whether a context-manager agent is installed.

requirements.name: project build/test tooling (bundlers, test runners, monorepo tools)
requirements.evidence: "2. Review current build times, tooling setup"; "Measure baseline"; "Profile build times"
requirements.basis: "install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, npm, apt from Ubuntu, go modules, nuget, GitHub release downloads), build, test, run CLIs and scripts"

requirements.name: developer surveys
requirements.evidence: "Survey developers"; "Satisfaction surveys" (list items, not numbered steps)
requirements.basis: Only "ask_user": "ask the user a question (with options) and read the answer in the conversation" is available; no survey tool or team access is listed.

requirements.name: remote caching / distributed builds
requirements.basis: Depends on the cache host; "hosts not listed are unknown" and accounts for SaaS products are lacking.

notes: Step 1 'Query context manager' is a numbered step, so I marked it hard, but the manifest is silent about a context-manager agent; status unknown, does not block. Other reading: if the context manager is treated as an integration not listed ("connectors or integrations other than the tools listed"), it is unavailable and the verdict would be BLOCKED on other:context-manager. Unknown: surveys, remote caching hosts.
